Запускаю единый финальный прогон: typecheck, Jest, lint, production iOS bundle, live CoinGecko, проверка отсутствия геолокационного разрешения и чистоты рабочего дерева. Жду RESULT worker.

{"version":1,"taskId":"d5737cb5-cd35-40eb-9665-57c14891fb74","commandId":"acceptance-1","operation":"run","headSha":"51b38f0e713aa53ea9cd86f046e0e62f42cae086","command":"set -e
printf '\n=== HEAD / STATUS BEFORE ===\n'
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short
printf '\n=== LOCATION PERMISSIONS ===\n'
if grep -n 'NSLocation' ios/Delete2/Info.plist; then echo 'ERROR: unexpected NSLocation key found' >&2; exit 1; else echo 'No NSLocation keys in Info.plist'; fi
printf '\n=== TYPECHECK ===\n'
npx tsc --noEmit
printf '\n=== JEST ===\n'
npm test -- --runInBand
printf '\n=== LINT ===\n'
npm run lint
printf '\n=== PRODUCTION IOS JS BUNDLE ===\n'
rm -rf /tmp/delete2-acceptance-assets /tmp/delete2-acceptance.jsbundle
npx react-native bundle --platform ios --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output /tmp/delete2-acceptance.jsbundle --assets-dest /tmp/delete2-acceptance-assets
printf '\n=== LIVE COINGECKO ===\n'
node -e "fetch('https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/coins/markets?vs_currency=usd&ids=bitcoin,ethereum,solana,binancecoin,ripple&order=market_cap_desc&sparkline=false&price_change_percentage=24h').then(async r=>{console.log('HTTP',r.status);if(!r.ok)process.exit(2);const x=await r.json();console.log(x.map(v=>v.symbol.toUpperCase()+':'+v.current_price).join(' | '));const ids=new Set(x.map(v=>v.id));for(const id of ['bitcoin','ethereum','solana','binancecoin','ripple'])if(!ids.has(id))throw new Error('missing '+id)}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1)})"
printf '\n=== STATUS AFTER ===\n'
git status --short","timeoutSeconds":1200}
